timing: Specified without inspecting empirical v3 trait-environment coefficients. V2 outcomes and earlier synthetic conditional-interval limitations are already known; not preregistration.
point_estimator: For each module coordinate, the versioned joint Gaussian random-slope model supplies its within hypermean. Equal-observation phenotype, predictor and nuisance means over exactly the same rows supply one equal-weight among regression row per taxon. Shared original units/transforms are unchanged across scales and bootstrap draws. Among nuisance columns include the means of observation-level spatial terms, not a basis of the centroid. The direct contrast is among minus within.
partition_before_filtering: On the full eligible source, define fixed longitude/latitude cells at both2degrees and5degrees. Union cells touched by one known dependence component; separately union taxon levels touched by one component. These conservative closures retain bridges through observations missing from a later module. Then restrict the already computed labels to that module. Report numbers/sizes and collapse; a collapsed factor is not replaced with row resampling.
crossed_cases_resampling: Independently sample the represented taxon-closure levels and represented spatial-closure levels with replacement, using the same number of draws as levels. Observation multiplicities are the product of the two factor multiplicities. Taxon-closure copies receive distinct taxon-copy labels for refitting; repeated spatial selections remain repeated rows within that taxon copy. Every supplied dependence component has one multiplicity, even if it crosses taxa or cells. All module coordinates and among/within fits share each draw. This is a crossed cases/pigeonhole candidate, not a proof of validity for nonlinear REML estimates.
two_grids: Always retain both2degree and5degree results. No coefficient-driven choice of grid or threshold. These finite blocks do not guarantee control of dependence beyond their size or remove phylogenetic dependence.
seed_rule: Each draw uses numpy SeedSequence([execution_seed, replicate_index, grid_degrees]); sampling depends only on the precomputed source partition and aligned cohort positions, not trait values. Reusing the same seeds/partitions across technical measurement formulations preserves their pairing.
joint_covariance: Retain the complete bootstrap coefficient vector ordered scale(within,among,among_minus_within), response coordinate, predictor. Estimate its full sample covariance; the contrast covariance must equal Vamong+Vwithin-Cov(among,within)-Cov(within,among), not just the sum of variances.
candidate_statistic: For each whole process block across all module coordinates, form a covariance-standardized quadratic statistic using the covariance's numerical range. Scale covariance to correlation units before a relative1e-10 eigenvalue rank check. A nonzero effect outside that range is not estimable, never silently projected away. Rank0 is not a test. Center each bootstrap coefficient vector on the observed vector and compare quadratic discrepancies with the observed zero-null statistic; report (1+exceedances)/(B+1) as a candidate bootstrap tail estimate, not an exact permutation P. Basic percentile-reflection intervals are also candidate intervals.
replicate_failure: Save all planned draws and all fit/identification failures with no redraw. An incomplete bootstrap retains successful coefficient vectors diagnostically but yields no covariance, interval or tail estimate for that module/grid. Do not condition inference on successful replicates.
production_requirement: Before any ecological probabilities: qualify null rejection, coverage, variance heterogeneity, crossed/spatial dependence, module rank, actual cohort support and the complete36slot family. Production requires at least1999planned draws per grid, giving enough tail resolution for the36slot Holm family; fewer-draw synthetic pilots are implementation diagnostics only. No calibration or ecological admission follows just from implementing this candidate.
measurement: Technical bbox/photometric formulations remain a paired sensitivity envelope, not samples from a calibrated biological-error distribution. Qualification and matched support must precede empirical fitting; this generic numerical runner does not select endpoints or authorize a changed colour definition.

sources.title: Owen2007, The pigeonhole bootstrap
sources.scope: Separate factor resampling for crossed unbalanced arrays; its mean-consistency results do not prove coverage of this nonlinear mixed-model/scale-contrast estimator.

sources.title: Loy and Korobova, Bootstrapping Clustered Data in R using lmeresampler
